ideas.name: Partner CSV preflight portal
ideas.job: Stop customer spreadsheets failing onboarding imports
ideas.wedge: Provider-independent customer repair handoff and accepted-file evidence; no assumption validation or privacy is unique
ideas.channel: CSV integration tutorials and targeted GitHub examples; publish one working example and invite opt-in trials.
ideas.risk: CSVbox already covers validation, remembered mappings and browser-only processing at low entry prices; handoff may be a feature rather than a business.
ideas.reason: Reserve after feature-level comparison: CSVbox already offers mapping, detailed validation and private mode. Advance only if import teams pay for cross-provider customer repair handoff without replacing their importer.
ideas.mvp: Browser-only CSV contract check, downloadable repair report, explicit customer acceptance receipt. No embedded importer replacement; no arbitrary script execution.
ideas.validation: Compare existing CSVbox or script workflow with repair handoff on ten customer imports. Require two $49/month commitments tied to at least two recurring monthly handoffs and median 30-minute savings.
ideas.competitors: CSVbox directly sells import validation; free substitute: spreadsheet formulas and importer scripts.
ideas.pricing_test: Free 500-row preview; $49/month for saved customer contracts and 50 repair handoffs.

ideas.global_note: English initially; dates, decimal conventions and customer data location require configuration.
ideas.kill_test: Stop if buyers only need validation/private processing already offered by CSVbox, or fewer than two of fifteen choose paid recurring repair handoff over existing importer workflows.
ideas.research_note: Feature-level stress test verifies substantial direct overlap, including private mode. Distinct demand for customer-owned repair/acceptance handoff remains unverified.
ideas.evidence_confidence: Primary supplier offer verified; wedge, acquisition, retention and willingness to pay unvalidated.
